title: findr ditches MusicBrainz for Deezer and streaming indexers
author: agy
body:
- findr ditches MusicBrainz due to high rate-limiting, complex medium taxonomy, and poor/delayed coverage for underground/modern digital releases.
- Deezer API is chosen as the default zero-auth metadata indexer: provides instant artist discography, native album/ep/single/compilation classification, tracklists, durations, and ISRCs with no developer keys required.
- Qobuz and Spotify are secondary pluggable indexers: Qobuz provides 1:1 fidelity for downloads, Spotify provides deep catalog matching.
- Downloader pipeline integrates Qobuz (FLAC/Hi-Res) and slskd/Soulseek for rare tracks.
- Verifier scores track counts, duration tolerances (+-4s), and fuzzy titles before tagging and importing to Navidrome library.

title: findr Docker deployment, Qobuz token authentication, and discography tracking
author: agy
body:
- findr Docker container uses multi-stage Alpine build with non-root user, curl healthcheck, and ENTRYPOINT ["findr"] CMD ["daemon"].
- Qobuz user token authentication supported directly via FINDR_QOBUZ_USER_TOKEN or config.yaml, passing X-User-Auth-Token header and query param.
- Track & Get Everything pipeline (findr track <artist>) indexes all albums, EPs, and singles, verifies audio files against canonical indexer metadata, imports into /music, and triggers a single Navidrome Subsonic startScan at the end of the batch.
- Web UI on port 8686 provides real-time search, one-click Track & Get Everything, and manual Navidrome scan trigger.

title: findr single-album tracking, playlist import and file manager design
author: claude
body:
- Single album: POST /api/albums {source_id, download} → Orchestrator.AddAlbum. Artist is created with monitored=false so the 6h scheduler does not index the whole discography. EnqueueAllMissingReleases also picks up monitored albums of unmonitored artists.
- AddArtist now preserves existing album status/monitored/tracks on re-index (previously the 6h sync reset completed albums to pending via the SaveAlbum upsert).
- Playlists (table `playlists`, id "spotify-<id>"): tracks resolve to indexer albums; findr downloads whole releases (album-centric pipeline), and writes <music>/Playlists/<name>.m3u8 with relative paths to just the playlist's tracks. M3U refresh runs in ProcessAlbumPipelineWithJob before the Navidrome scan. Unticked releases are stored in excluded_album_ids and skipped on sync; sync only adds releases new to the library.
- Optional indexer capabilities are separate interfaces (indexer.AlbumSearcher, TrackSearcher, ISRCResolver) so test mocks of Indexer keep compiling.
- File manager (internal/files) is sandboxed to roots music/downloads; Resolve anchors ".." at the root and checks symlink targets. Deleting a library folder calls MarkDeletedPath to reset matching releases to pending (local-* records are deleted).

title: findr web UI: graphite glass redesign, embedded web/ files, mobile tab bar
author: claude
body:
- UI moved out of the dashboardHTML Go string into internal/server/web/{index.html,app.css,app.js}; go:embed + strings.Replacer inlines CSS (/*__APP_CSS__*/) and JS (//__APP_JS__) at startup, so / still serves one self-contained page (TestDashboardServed checks for "Search & Add", id="view-artist", openArtistPage).
- Look (2026-11-17, from user's inspiration shots): graphite #0f1012, collapsible sidebar (88px rail, state in localStorage findr.sidebar) with Settings sub-tree, glass "folder" artist cards (image back + frosted front with clip-path tab), pill buttons/segmented controls, frosted ⋯ menu, white primary pill. Fonts Geist / Geist Mono.
- Accent is mint #8ee3c8 + peach, not the purple of the inspiration: taste-skill bans violet. One token swap in :root if the user wants purple.
- Mobile (<=860px): sidebar hidden, floating bottom tab bar (5 tabs), batch bar + save bar float above it, rows reflow, 44px targets.
- Routing is hash-only: links href="#view"; go(hash) sets the hash; handleRoute dispatches. Settings tabs are #settings/<tab>. Preview pages (#artist/preview-ID) fall back to search on reload.
- Fixed during the redesign: manual import sent numeric artist/album IDs (API wants strings); queue cancel sent a number (string expected); names with apostrophes broke inline handlers (jsq helper); removed fake hardcoded "FLAC 24-BIT" quality pills.
- Test locally with a copied DB + downloaders/navidrome disabled on another port; the binary must be rebuilt for UI changes (files are embedded).

title: Spotify playlist reading: Web API items are restricted, embed page caps at 100
author: claude
body:
- Since Feb 2026 Dev Mode changes, playlist entries moved from /playlists/{id}/tracks to /items and `items` is only returned for some playlists (owned ones). Client-credentials calls often get 403 or metadata only.
- internal/spotify tries the Web API (if indexer.spotify creds set) and falls back to https://open.spotify.com/embed/playlist/{id}: parse <script id="__NEXT_DATA__">, props.pageProps.state.data.entity.trackList[] {uri,title,subtitle,duration ms}. Artists in subtitle are split on "," with U+00A0 after the comma.
- Embed lists at most 100 tracks and has no ISRC/album → Playlist.Partial flag; tracks resolve via Deezer /search/track (artist:"X" track:"Y"), ISRC path uses /track/isrc:CODE.
- Resolution is paced at 200ms/track with 4 workers to stay under Deezer's ~50 req/5s; 50-track playlist ≈ 10s.

title: Album import failures: slskd 500 "wait timed out", Qobuz unexpected EOF, Artist-NN-Title names
author: claude
body:
- slskd enqueue 500 "The wait timed out after 5000 milliseconds" = the peer did not answer; not our bug. Fix: slskd Download/DownloadTrack try up to maxPeerAttempts (5) ranked peers, one attempt per peer.
- Qobuz: some hi-res (format 27) streams are cut short every time (unexpected EOF, ~1-byte file) — seen on Currents track 24770699. downloadTrackWithFallbackFormats steps 27 -> 7 -> 6 (never to MP3); downloadToFile checks bytes vs Content-Length and rejects <1KB.
- Qobuz Download now continues past a failed track and returns a failed job listing all failed tracks (before, it aborted at the first one and tracks after it were never tried).
- FallbackDownloader still RemoveAll(targetDir) before the slskd album fallback (mixing sources would confuse the verifier); its error now includes the primary's reason.
- Verifier: Soulseek rips named "Artist - NN - Title" scored ~0.51 (no track number parsed). trackEmbeddedRegex handles "Artist - [Album -] [D-]NN - Title" and "Artist - NN. Title".
